region.why: a deployment fact: HCAZERRS ASSIGNs SYSID into the message it writes; the corpus names no region

notes: The example-health-apis visit-add front end HCV1BA01, LINKed with a COMMAREA: after the length checks it LINKs HCAVDB01 (which inserts the BLOODPRESSURE and HEARTRATE rows) and RETURNs. Tables come from the estate's @DB2CRE.jcl (HCZMSA1). scenarios.name: add-visit
scenarios.why: LINKs HCAVDB01, which inserts one BLOODPRESSURE and one HEARTRATE row: CA-RETURN-CODE '00', front end RETURNs

scenarios.name: no-commarea
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE (LINK HCAZERRS) then ABEND HCCA, before the LINK to HCAVDB01

scenarios.name: short-commarea
scenarios.why: one byte under the 18-byte header: '98', RETURN before INSERT-VISIT

scenarios.name: duplicate-bloodpressure
scenarios.why: seed.sql holds a BLOODPRESSURE row for patient 2 at this timestamp: HCAVDB01's INSERT is -803 and returns '90'; the front end sees CA-RETURN-CODE > 0 and RETURNs
